notes: 30 themes and 10 clock styles (digital, flip, analog, segment, binary, words and more), with 11 digit animations.
Living scenes: Forest, Ocean, Sunset, Space, Synthwave, Winter and City, with the real moon phase, and birds that carry in each new minute.
Your own background picture, any size: fill, show all, stretch, actual size or tile, then zoom and place it anywhere.
See-through backgrounds, clear or frosted glass, that hide the taskbar when fullscreen.
Match the background: the clock picks its own colors from your picture, background color or desktop.
Alarms, a timer and a stopwatch. Alarms ring even with the clock hidden, and can wake the PC.
Always opens on the display it was last on, waits for screens that connect late, and moves back when one reconnects.
A pin that keeps the clock above every other window.
Uses almost no power: Windows efficiency mode, pauses when nobody can see it, and starts gently at sign-in.
Counts the total time it has been open, which never resets.
Settings laid out like Windows 11, with a search box, and a slim top bar with the pages, the pin and Settings.
Updates itself from the download page.
